description: Which district is an Indian town or locality in? Returns matches with district, state, the basis (a town page with a Local Government Directory district, or India Post's label that the directory does not confirm) and a link to the page. About 19,000 towns and localities; old names such as Bangalore or Gurgaon resolve. Source: India Post via GeoNames (CC BY 4.0) and the Local Government Directory (GODL).

state.description: Optional state name to narrow the match, e.g. "Andhra Pradesh".

name: lookup_place
title: Indian place name to district
